scripts.build: vp run -r build && pnpm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: cp packages/sdk/dist/index.iife.js packages/server/public/sdk.js && cp -r apps/console/dist/* packages/server/public/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json
